title: Iginio Straffi
summary:
Iginio Straffi is the founder and president of the Rainbow S.p.A. studio, which he jointly owns with the American company ViacomCBS. He is the creator and director of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. 

In creating the show, Iginio Straffi stated that his goal was to create a "cultured alternative to Japanese manga and American cartoons, giving viewers the opportunity to learn about Italian and European culture."

Iginio Straffi is the founder and president of the Rainbow S.p.A. studio, which he jointly owns with the American company ViacomCBS. He is the creator and director of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. [wikipedia:Iginio Straffi]

In creating the show, Iginio Straffi stated that his goal was to create a "cultured alternative to Japanese manga and American cartoons, giving viewers the opportunity to learn about Italian and European culture."
